secrets.name: JWT_ACCESS_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs the access tokens that carry the tenant (organizationId) and permissions. The API refuses to start without a real value (>= 32 chars, not a known placeholder). Generated for this sandbox; replace it with your own before any shared deployment (openssl rand -hex 32).

secrets.name: MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Encrypts MFA secrets and stored HR/SIS provider credentials. Must be exactly 64 hex characters (32 bytes). Generated for this sandbox; replacing it makes previously stored encrypted provider secrets unreadable, so pair a change with re-entering them.
